observedFacts.fact: The combined Dabas district includes Alsódabas, Felsődabas, Szőlőhegy and Öregországút. Its outer transitions toward Sári and Gyón are Tulipán and Határ streets.
Sári lies between the woodland/canal setting, the industrial-park edge and Felsődabas; its old core lies between Hajcsár and Tabáni streets.
The functional civic center follows Bartók Béla toward route 5 and includes institutions around Szent István tér; it differs from the older mansion district.
Öregországút is a small, separately named former-road settlement.
Gyón meets Dabas at Határ street. Vasút and Luther define its old core; Vacsi, Rabárerdő and Örkényi identify its wider development.
